name: nod_axis_calibration_yawed_earbud
description: Earbud yawed 25 deg in the ear (mountYaw). Calibrate, beginAxisCalibration at 11 s, nod down to 25 deg and back (12-14.6 s), then 20 deg forward from 20-23 s held to 68 s. Expect the nod to be learned (yaw ~25 deg), one forward reminder, and |lateral| below 3 deg during the hold (default axes would read ~8.5 deg lateral, 18.1 deg forward).
